column1: # Destination drift exceptions — curated suppression list for the
# destinationDrift cache scan (shortestpath.dump.DestinationDriftTest).
# The scan flags every destination TSV row whose tile has no
# interaction-capable object within 3 tiles in a live OSRS cache. Some
# destinations are unverifiable by an object scan by design:
# NPC-serviced banks and shops (a banker is an NPC, not an object),
# instanced interiors the cache stores at other coordinates, and
# objects spawned server-side that never appear in map placements.
# Listing a tile here suppresses the finding for exactly that tile.
# Row contract: "X Y Z<TAB>reason" — the coordinate in the same
# space-separated three-part form the Destination column uses, then a
# human reason explaining why the row is by-design unverifiable. A row
# without both parts aborts the scan (a suppression that might be a
# typo must not silently pass).
# Curate entries as findings are triaged.
# NPC-serviced banks — the banker is an NPC, not an object.
